referenceEnvironment.notes: Reference conditions for propagation timing and future atmospheric absorption. Runtime uses source-class approximations rather than full octave-band ISO 9613 solving.

voiceShout.description: Strong battlefield shout; audible farther than it remains intelligible.

smallArms.description: Rifle/carbine/LMG/pistol impulse class. NIOSH notes firearm impulses commonly reach roughly 160-170 dB peak and can reach 170-180 dB or higher.

runtimeModel.airAbsorption: distance increases high-frequency loss; full ISO 9613-1 band filtering reserved for filtered/distant asset layers
runtimeModel.dynamicRange: Physical source SPL is mapped through a game-mix compressor so a phone speaker can represent both speech and gunfire without clipping.
